params.body:
Third step for `consent`, `dns`, `exposure`, `forge`, `search`, `git` and `deps`. A round over the fleet this morning wrote verdicts on every measured row of the seven, so the word mapping next to each line goes, and a facet Elixir did not judge is `background`, never `ok`.

With this every card on the dashboard renders Elixir's verdict and nothing else. The brief will say `source: elixir` for every measurement once the remaining old rows are re-measured (hoet-design-web takes no measurement request at the moment; its cards say "not yet").

The test double `JudgedRows` now covers the seven keys as well, for the older tests that build rows from facts alone (Consent, MailAuth, Forge, Exposure and WorklistEvidence card tests joined the list). Docs: the brief contract and the paper say that no card holds a rule of its own since 2026-09-13. Suite green except the worktree-only `BuildStampTest`; PHPStan and Pint clean.
params.title: No card holds a rule of its own, third round
